Subject: Follow-up & draft validation checklist from today's discovery

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for the 30-minute call this morning. I captured the high-level POC scope and a proposed validation checklist so we can run a tight, measurable trial. Key points below; attaching a short POC-scope PDF and a first-cut MAP spreadsheet.

Summary (what we heard)
- Objective: Replace internal FAQ triage pipeline for clinician support to reduce time-to-answer and triage cost by 40%.
- Priority success metrics: (1) End-to-end triage time reduction (median), (2) Accuracy vs. benchmark answers (>=85% intent/slot alignment), (3) Latency p95 under 400ms for short prompts.
- Data: You will provide ~2k de-identified conversation pairs and a 200-case evaluation set.

Proposed 6-week POC (high level)
1) Week 0 (alignment): Confirm success criteria, access, and SIEM/ SOC2 checkpoints.
2) Week 1–2 (baseline + ingest): Baseline evaluation on your eval set; model config and prompt engineering.
3) Week 3–4 (iterative tuning): Two tuning cycles, quality review, and user-acceptance checks.
4) Week 5 (stability): Run 48-hour production-like load (staged) and measure latency/cost.
5) Week 6 (readout): Executive decision meeting (go/no-go) and next-contract ask.

Owners (proposed)
- Redwood: Alex (engage & MAP owner), Marissa (solutions / evaluation owner).
- MedLogic: Daniel (POC sponsor), Security/Procurement as needed.

Asks from you this week
- Confirm the evaluation set delivery timeline (CSV or S3 link).
- Confirm availability for an executive 30–45 minute decision slot during week of Sept 7 (two proposed windows in the MAP).
- Any mandatory compliance evidence we should surface up-front (SOC2 scope, encryption, retention limits).

If that aligns, I can convert the attached MAP into a calendar invite and route a short pre-read one week before exec review.

Thanks — I left a tentative calendar card on my side for Sept 8 & 10 (per our cadence).

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: POC-scope-v1.pdf (summary), MAP-MedLogic-2026.xlsx (mutual action plan)

Subject: Re: Follow-up & draft validation checklist from today's discovery

Alex —

Appreciate the clear recap. This looks good as a starting point. A few clarifications from our side:
- Evaluation set: We can export the 200-case set and should have it sanitized by Aug 22; will share an S3 link.
- Success metric tweak: For accuracy, can we be explicit about the scoring rubric? We use a 3-tier pass/fail and need >= 80% pass on critical intents, 75% overall.
- Security: SOC2 type II is in scope; encryption-in-transit and at-rest required; retention must be deletable on request for test datasets.

Procurement loop: I've cc'd procurement — they will expect a short SOW + standard DPA. We prefer a single SOW for the POC and a follow-up commercial SOW if we progress.

Exec slot: Sept 8 or Sept 10 both work for me. If you need, book Sept 8 10:00–10:30 PT and we'll try to lock it.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Cho
Head of Platform | MedLogic Health
daniel.cho@medlogic.com
